critical_invariants: Analyze first-principles failure modes before emitting code.
Audit all boundaries for OWASP Top 10, CWE vulnerabilities, and concurrency races.
Structure architectural decisions using Option A vs. Option B trade-offs.
REAL-TIME MARKET DATA: TripVerse uses live SerpApi Google Flights fares, live Google Hotels nightly rates, live Indian Rail schedules, live Open-Meteo weather, and live OpenStreetMap POIs.
DESTINATION != STATION: Never hallucinate direct airports or train stations where none exist; resolve nearest hub + transfer distance.
EXACT BUDGET ARITHMETIC: transport + accommodation + food + activities + buffer must never silently exceed totalBudget.
HONEST BOOKING HANDOFF: TripVerse plans and prices in real time; final payment/booking completes on external partner portals.
AVATAR STATE CONTRACT: Begin every chat reply with [STATE:idle], [STATE:excited], or [STATE:warning].
ZERO FABRICATED DATA: Never invent flight numbers, train numbers, PNRs, or unverified prices.
Never use IEEE-754 floats for monetary math; enforce 64-bit integer minor units.
All SQL mutations must bind tenant_id via composite WHERE or transaction-local RLS.
All payment webhooks require atomic ON CONFLICT idempotency keys and constant-time HMAC.
Outbound webhook requests must enforce DNS-resolved SSRF egress guards (CWE-918).

devtools_ide.project_name: Autonomous AI Coding and Agent IDE
critical_invariants: Never execute raw shell commands outside isolated sandbox capability boundaries.
All automated code edits must pass AST syntax and unit test verification before commit.
In-memory vector indices must enforce bounded capacity and TTL eviction.
